FDT is a useful theory of religion, but that it needs to be modified and extended to account more fully for the phenomenological and developmental nature of religion.

FDT is not a theory about the development of religion but a theory about the cognitive development of religion, and that it does not provide a comprehensive and detailed picture of the religious development of the individual.

religious styles are the most important factor in the development of religious beliefs and practices.
we should not only consider the cognitive development of religious faith, but also the interpersonal and life-world dimensions.
